classification.direct-text: Direct browser text insertion or paste; Unicode/source correctness only
classification.synthetic-composition: Programmatically dispatched events; lifecycle guards only

acceptance.native: Record OS/input source/runtime hashes, actual candidate, event trust/composition, AX/screenshot, saved bytes and observed history unit
acceptance.platforms: macOS WKWebView and Windows WebView2 require separate real-host evidence
